source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.4.2.2 (PDF 143, printed 140).

blocks.text: Model ka output samajhne (interpret karne) ka matlab hai jaanna ke nataij hamein kya batate hain.

Misal: Agar hamara linear regression model dikhaye ke parhai ke ghante exam scores par gehra asar dalte hain, to hum nateeja nikal sakte hain ke students ko apne scores behtar karne ke liye zyada ghante parhna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Stall model mein 40 ka slope dukaan ke maalik ko kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Har izafi customer taqreeban 40 rupay kamai barhata hai, is liye zyada customers lana kamai barhane ka bunyadi tareeqa hai.

items: Output samajhna: model ke nataij se kaam ka nateeja nikalna (zyada parhai, behtar scores).
